note: Corps of Engineers campground on a wooded hillside beside Lake Ashtabula (Baldhill Dam), about 15 miles north of Valley City; swim beach, playground and picnic shelter in the campground, with a dump station, boat ramp and fishing pier within walking distance. --Claude
summary: rec.gov record + catalog: 36 sites (30 electric RV/Tent/Trailer sites, 27-79 ft, plus 6 walk-to tent sites); $26 standard, $20 walk-to, $52 double; 14 nights in 30; showers, flush toilets, drinking water. Electric 50 -> 30 (the lone '50' attribute on site 15 contradicts that site's own 30). Not waterfront stands (RV sites behind the shoreline tree band; the open shore is the swim beach). Phone missing -> 701-845-2970. Pin ok.
flags: ELECTRIC 50 -> 30: the stored 50 (RIDB-derived) rests on site 15's 'Electric Hookup: 50', but the same site's 'Electricity Hookup' is 30, and every other electric site is 30 on both attributes. Snapped down to 30.
PHONE (missing): recreation.gov gives facility_phone 701-845-2970 (the Corps' Lake Ashtabula / Baldhill Dam office, the same number on Eggerts Landing). Suggest '' -> 701-845-2970.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront stands. North RV sites 21, 22 and 23/24 (about 47.1592,-98.0035) sit 20-30 m from the shore, but behind a continuous shoreline tree band. West sites 12-14 (about 47.1585,-98.0050) are ~25-30 m from the water through the same woods, beside the swim beach (day use). The open sand clearing on the north shore holds walk-to tent sites 18-20, not RV sites. The rec.gov description calls it 'a wooded hillside'. At most a filtered lakeview from 21/22 that imagery cannot confirm, so no change.
SITE COUNT: the catalog has 36 sites (30 electric, 6 walk-to tent); the stored 38 and the description's '38 campsites, 32 of which offer electric' are older. Written 36.
SEASON: rec.gov rate seasons run 2026-05-15..09-30 and 2027-05-14..09-30; that is a rate season, not a campground statement. No season written; none stored.
FIT: all 30 RV sites take 23 ft (27-79 ft); RV, Tent and Trailer permitted on every one.

PIN: stored 47.15789,-98.00422 is ~60 m from the catalog centroid 47.15845,-98.00411; keep. The USACE district page was not tried (earlier batches found the Corps' ND pages refuse plain HTTP); rec.gov is the authority.
